newsitem.title: USA: First Industrial Realty files $589 mln shelf.
newsitem.headline: First Industrial Realty files $589 mln shelf.

text.p: First Industrial Realty Trust Inc said Wednesday it filed a universal shelf registration covering common and preferred stock, depositary shares and debt securities having an aggregate maximum offering price of $589 million.
The registration includes $89 million from a previous shelf that was filed jointly by First Industrial Realty Trust and its operating partnership, First Industrial LP.
Proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, which may include the acquisition or development of additional properties and repayment of debt.
First Industrial is a real estate investment trust that owns, manages, acquires and develops warehouse and light industrial properties in 17 U.S. markets.
Its current portfolio includes 419 in-service properties comprising more than 36 million square feet.
